objective: Add a framework-free Cloud IaC OpenTofu module-registry REST router boundary registered with oya-http-router-kernel, exposing official GET discovery/versions/download templates, low-cardinality match metadata, path captures, and route-specific authorization surfaces while preserving no API dispatch from the rest layer, live HTTP listener/server, auth runtime, database/object-store, signing, SLSA/VSA, tofu plan/apply, provider runtime, FD-001 workload hosting, or cloud provisioning claims.

best_practice_sources.what_it_establishes: OpenTofu clients discover services through /.well-known/terraform.json and modules.v1 service base URLs.
The module registry protocol uses GET versions and download routes under the modules.v1 base.
Versioned registry sources are the reusable module distribution mechanism; credentials/runtime concerns remain separate from source strings.

module_registry_rest_router.architecture_boundary_correction: The rest crate is router-only and intentionally does not depend on oya-cloud-iac-api; future composition must occur in an architecture-compliant app/runtime layer.
module_registry_rest_router.dogfood_substrate_alignment: FD-001 remains the product goal; this slice advances Cloud IaC substrate route-table lock-in but does not host FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads.

implemented_claims: Added oya-cloud-iac-rest as a workspace member and registry/catalog REST package for the Cloud IaC module-registry router boundary.
Registered exactly three OpenTofu module registry GET templates with oya-http-router-kernel.
Exposed low-cardinality matched_template strings, path captures, and route-specific authorization surface metadata.
Tests prove route registration, template/capture matching, wrong-method refusal, unknown/incomplete path refusal, dot-segment capture refusal, whitespace path refusal, and surface metadata mapping.
Corrected an initial architecture-boundary violation by removing the REST layer dependency on the API crate.
explicit_non_claims: no API crate dependency or API DTO dispatch from the rest layer
no live HTTP listener or Hyper server composition
no registry publish path or object-store serving
no authentication or Cedar runtime integration beyond surface metadata
no module signing or Sigstore/cosign execution
no SLSA or VSA attestation generation
no provider runtime, provider API calls, provider credentials, or cloud provisioning
no FD-001 microservice dogfood tenant workload hosting or production tenant workload evidence
false_green_findings_closed: Avoided claiming live REST service readiness: the new crate is a framework-free router boundary only.
Avoided violating architecture boundaries by removing rest -> api dependency and documenting future composition needs.
Avoided treating router matches as deployed endpoint, auth runtime, persistence, signing, provider execution, or FD-001 dogfood evidence.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed by this ChangeSet; repo-wide unrelated blockers remain outside this Cloud IaC slice.

Cloud IaC still needs future slices for an architecture-compliant app/runtime composition that combines router matches with API DTO dispatch, an actual HTTP listener, live service discovery and module versions/download endpoints, registry publish path, object-store serving, authentication/Cedar runtime integration, database adapter, module signing/Sigstore/cosign, SLSA attestations, independent provider provenance/VSA verification, tofu tests, plan/apply evidence, provider-resource-complete modules, and live GitOps/provider integration evidence.

FD-001 remains the master-plan product delivery goal and Oyatie Cloud must later prove itself by hosting FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads; this ChangeSet provides no tenant-workload dogfood evidence.
Concurrent unrelated application-shell and other agent work exists in the worktree; this ChangeSet does not claim or modify those surfaces.

findings: Small router-only crate; architecture-boundary feedback removed the premature rest -> api dependency.
Moves Cloud IaC toward a service substrate by registering official module-registry templates in the canonical router kernel while retaining runtime non-claims.
FD-001 dogfood tenant workload hosting remains a future substrate proof, not a claim in this ChangeSet.
Tests reject wrong methods, unknown/incomplete paths, dot-segment captures, and whitespace-mutated paths.
Route constants, match struct, and required_surface metadata provide a simple handoff for future app/runtime composition.
No new external dependencies; fmt, tests, check, clippy, architecture, and run-all gates passed.
Chose router-only REST boundary instead of live server or rest->api dispatch because the architecture gate forbids rest -> api edges.
Router kernel rejects dot-segment captures; matched_template remains low-cardinality and does not include tenant/module capture values.
Router table has three static templates and bounded capture maps; no runtime I/O added.
Evidence, manifest, tasks, and audit chain preserve local-only scope and non-claims.
Route templates mirror OpenTofu remote service discovery and module registry v1 docs.
Manifest, tasks/plan, tasks/todo, catalog, multispectrum evidence, and audit chain updated.
Future app/runtime layer can consume route matches and required_surface metadata; no live operation is claimed.
Oya VCS claim/work lifecycle used; no raw git/gh; architecture-boundaries correction honored.
OpenTofu official docs used for route shapes; repo-local gates distinguish route-table evidence from runtime evidence.
Explicitly excludes API dispatch from rest, live endpoints, auth runtime, persistence, signing/SLSA, provider runtime, plan/apply, cloud provisioning, full verify, and FD-001 tenant workload hosting.
